suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: The whole DNA/ORI/ORC/license stack is squeezed into the narrow B-C band (y~145-250), leaving rows A, D, E, F empty; this vertical compression is what forces the license keys and the 'per cycle' captions to collide with the ORI/ORC labels.; Solution: Line 30: self.place_in_area(dna_group, 'C1', 'C6', scale_factor=0.9) to center the strand on row C (y~227). Keep ORI labels 0.35 unit above the strand (row B side) and ORC labels 0.35 unit below the rings, freeing row A for the license keys and row D for the firing captions.

[LAYOUT] Problem: During licensing (frames ~10-11s) the purple key symbols and their 'License' texts land on top of the yellow ORI labels and overlap each other ('LicenseLicense' at the right end), with the last text reaching x~800 near the screen edge.; Solution: Line 62: self.place_at_grid(license_group[i], 'A1'/'A2'/'A3'/'A4'/'A5', scale_factor=0.5) so each key+label sits one full row above its origin (row A, y~113), text font reduced to ~16px; then FadeOut(license_labels) once the keys dock so nothing persists over the ORI row.

[LAYOUT] Problem: The five '1x per cycle' captions are wider than one grid column, so pairs 1-2 and 4-5 render as overlapping text ('1x per cycle1x per cycle') and the last one runs to the right border.; Solution: Line 80: self.place_at_grid(cycle_label[i], 'D1', 'D2', 'D3', 'D4', 'D5', scale_factor=0.45) (font ~14px, color #BFBFBF) placing each caption on row D (y~288) directly under its ORC ring, one grid unit from the origin and clear of the ORC labels.
